note: Condenser-side flow temperature of the heat pump itself (before buffer/DHW valve). Equals fg=60/fn=254 dp 17 within 0.2 K over a full DHW run. Hoval's Modbus list carries this as 31892/31893, but the name column of that whole block (31892-31921) is shifted by rows in the public list -- trust the CAN dp, not the register name.
Return temperature at the heat pump. Equals fg=60/fn=254 dp 29 within 0.1 K. Modbus 31894/31895 (same name-shift caveat as dp 257).

Speed of the heat pump's internal circulation pump (Modbus 27495/27496 "CP rotation speed" -- that name is correct). Observed: 80 % on compressor start, then tracks modulation (roughly 0.73 x modulation % during a DHW run: 50->40->32->25->13 %), 30 % in standby/after-run with compressor off. **0xFFFFFFFF = pump off**, not a reading -- filter it, otherwise consumers show -1 or 4294967295.

Water volume flow through the heat pump (Modbus 31707/31708, name correct). 33.7 L/min at 80 % pump, 28.9 at 50 %, 26.1 at 40 %, 21.9 at 25 %, 16.1 at 30 % standby, 0 with pump off. Physics check: Q x (dp257 - dp258) x 4.18 / 60 reproduces the controller's own thermal power (12.7/14.4 kW computed vs 13/14 kW reported) -- i.e. this flow and the two temperatures are exactly what the heat-quantity counters are built from.

name_en: Primary flow / intake air (per Hoval list)
note: Reads 0x80000000 = sensor not fitted on an air-source UltraSource B (same for dp 260, 261, 273, 275, 276, 1570 -- ground-water/primary-circuit probes). Modbus 31896-31901.

Modbus 31903 (single 16-bit word; Hoval's list declares the block 31892-31921 as S32 pairs -- the second word 31904 does not belong to it). Equals pCO database entry 0106 of the compressor controller within 0.1 K (7/7 samples). Tracks the outdoor temperature (fg=0 dp 0) minus 0.5..1.5 K. AVAILABILITY: only answers in the 'post power-on' state (see note on dp 264); silent (GET unanswered, Modbus stays 0) in the other state.
Modbus 31905. Equals pCO database entry 0107 exactly (3/3). Idle: ~24 C; drops to 15-18 C right after compressor start. Availability as dp 262.

Modbus 31907. Equals pCO database entry 0108 (3/3). Idle: ~22-24 C (crankcase level); 65-81 C during a DHW run at 33-47 % modulation. AVAILABILITY -- important: on this UltraSource B comfort C17 the TopTronic answers EITHER the fg=60/fn=254 block dp 20-34 (error code, return temp, power, WEZ status) OR these fg=60/fn=7 refrigerant-circuit points, never both. Before a mains power cycle (20.08.-03.09.2026, 3500 samples) dp 262/263/264/514/518 were silent and fn=254 dp 20-34 answered; after switching the heat pump off/on (03.09. 21:15) it is exactly reversed and stays so through compressor runs (DHW + cooling, dp 21 = 255). What selects the mode is unknown (probably the object-list negotiation between TopTronic and the compressor controller at start-up). Consumers should handle both: poll both groups and treat 'no answer' as 'not available', not as 0.

Modbus 31913, 0.01 K. Equals pCO database entry 0202 within 0.1 K (= suction gas temp minus saturation temp of the low-side pressure; physics check with R410A: 12.05 bar g -> 15.9 C sat, 24.3 C suction - 8.38 K = 15.9 C). Availability as dp 262.
Modbus 31915, 0.01 bar. Equals pCO database entry 0206 within 0.05 bar (8/8). Idle 12-15 bar (tracks air temperature), drops to ~10 bar on compressor start. Availability as dp 262.

Modbus 31917, 0.01 bar. Equals pCO database entry 0207 within 0.3 bar (8 samples 04.09.2026 incl. run transients; idle 13.8-17.8 bar = low pressure + 0.1 bar, 31.7-35.2 bar during a DHW run at 55-58 C flow, 22 bar during cooling). Availability as dp 262. NOTE: Hoval's Modbus list has no usable name here (name column shifted); the value is unambiguously the discharge/high-side pressure.

Modbus 31919. Constant 1 since power-on, 0/silent before. Meaning unknown -- listed only so nobody mistakes it for 'high pressure 1' (that is the row Hoval's shifted name column shows). Availability as dp 262.

Modbus 31921, 0.1 %. Follows the compressor modulation (fg=60/fn=254 dp 30 / RS485 vector byte 30): 464-466 at 46-47 %, 398 at 40 %, 333 at 33 %, 350 at 35 %, 0 when the compressor is off. LIKELY the inverter's actual speed as % of maximum (same scale as modulation); a small lag against dp 30 is within the polling latency of the logger, so treat 'actual vs. setpoint' as unproven. Availability as dp 262.
